# Dora

## Overview

- **Age:** Seven to eight years old (volumes 1–2)  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031), [v2 c10 P48](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0048)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v2 c1 P32](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0032)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029)</sub>
- **Origin:** East Grafton, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Dora is a fair-complexioned girl with long, sleek hazel-colored curls that never get out of order. She has a straight nose and gentle, mild hazel eyes. Her mouth is described as 'prunes and prisms' style, and she wears a neat and proper expression.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P32](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0032), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025)_

## Personality

Dora is extraordinarily demure, quiet, and well-behaved, behaving so impeccably that she is described as being 'born already brought up.' She is neat, methodical, and obedient, diligently performing her chores without complaint. Unlike her twin brother Davy, she prefers order and stillness over mischief and adventures, though she can be timid and easily frightened.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000), [v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 c10 P88](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0088), [v2 c10 P89](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0089), [v2 c16 P16](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0016)_

## History

Dora Keith and her twin brother Davy were the children of Mary Keith, a relative of Marilla Cuthbert. Following her mother's illness and death in East Grafton, Dora and Davy were taken in by Marilla Cuthbert and Anne Shirley at Green Gables. Dora quickly adjusted to life at Green Gables, helping around the house and diligently attending to her small garden plot. She began attending Avonlea school alongside her brother, sitting with her classmate Mirabel Cotton. After their uncle died in British Columbia, leaving a trust fund for their care, Marilla and Anne formally decided to keep the twins permanently at Green Gables.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c7 P25](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0025), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c16 P16](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0016), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022)_
